content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑fat woven wheat crackers are light, crunchy biscuits made from whole‑grain wheat flour with part of the fat replaced by water and air bubbles. They are suitable for diet‑focused eating, retain the characteristic wheat flavor, and have a low calorie count.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The “woven” technique – a special way of interlacing the dough before baking – creates the delicate texture.
Fat is reduced to 2 g per 100 g, keeping the crunch without excess greasiness.
Wheat flour provides complex carbohydrates and dietary fiber.
Crackers are often used as a base for appetizers and canapés.
In many countries they are popular among athletes for their low‑calorie profile.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Reduced fat content makes these crackers suitable for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Wheat flour supplies slowly released energy, helping to maintain satiety.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and regular bowel function.

items.title: Moderate sodium
items.content: Most versions contain a modest amount of salt, which is beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: No trans fats
items.content: The fat‑reduction process eliminates the need for hydrogenated oils.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: The product contains gluten and is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some varieties may contain a small amount of sugar to enhance flavor.

items.title: Risk of over‑eating
items.content: The crunchy texture can lead to rapid consumption of large portions.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Crackers can be enjoyed as a standalone snack, used as a base for sandwiches, topped with cheese or avocado spreads, added to salads for crunch, or served alongside soups.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight package. For extended shelf life, keep refrigerated to preserve crispness.
